# Orbit

Orbit keeps a live index of a project's markdown files.

Run `make dev` to start it.

# Architecture

The watcher in src/index feeds the index; the AI gateway in src/ai is the only door to providers.

## Index

Batches of disk events are debounced for 200 ms before the index is updated.

# Guide

Open a folder with `orbit open <path>`.

# Agents

Cite the files you read.
